extension.description: AI assistant for BSL: inline completion, query previews, local diagnostics and templates for 1C developers.
command.generateQuery: 1C: Generate a query from a description
command.generateBatchQuery: 1C: Prepare a stock shortage query template
command.bspAssistant: 1C: Find a BSP method (Standard Subsystems Library)
command.auditStandards: 1C: Review BSL with local ITS hints
command.inspectQuery: 1C: Inspect a query with local ITS hints
command.refactorQuery: 1C: Prepare a batch from a query with a virtual JOIN
setting.autocompleteModel: BSL inline completion model. Configured separately from generation and explanations.
setting.reasoningModel: Model for query generation, AI BDD drafts and code explanations.
setting.debounceMs: Trailing debounce in milliseconds. A typing burst collapses into a request for the latest position (250 balances responsiveness and request volume).
setting.requestTimeoutMs: Inline completion HTTPS timeout in milliseconds. The request is destroyed when the timeout expires (25000 matches the gateway limit).
setting.maxCompletionLines: Maximum lines in one inline suggestion. Longer responses are rejected (20 keeps suggestions compact).
setting.maxCompletionChars: Maximum characters in one inline suggestion. Responses over the limit are rejected.
setting.contextBudgetChars: Hard character limit for prefix, suffix, metadata, BSP and neighboring modules. Current scope and cursor prefix take priority. Large contexts can increase cost and latency.
setting.completionDebug: Log inline completion timing and error categories to Output, without code, prompts or keys. Disabled by default.
setting.auditDisabledRules: Rules to disable in local BSL diagnostics and panel audit. Inline suppression: // normahub-disable-next-line ITS-PERF-001
